color_mood.instructions: Interpret the explicit color-grading intent in the creative brief and supplied project context. Select one approved LUT candidate only when the intended look is sufficiently clear. Use needs_review for ambiguous, conflicting, or underspecified creative intent. Never infer that a LUT has already been applied, and do not use the visual subject alone as proof of the requested mood.

criteria.warm_golden: A warm, golden, sunlit appearance with amber highlights.
criteria.teal_orange: A stylized teal-and-orange cinematic color separation.
criteria.cinematic_contrast: A controlled cinematic contrast look without a stronger specified color cast.
criteria.true_tone: A natural, restrained, faithful color appearance with realistic tones.
criteria.needs_review: The requested look is unclear, contradictory, or requires creative clarification.
